engine.name: Behringer PolyEight
engine.description: Behringer PolyEight 8-voice analog polysynth: every parameter of its manual's NRPN mappings, sent as 14-bit NRPNs, with the value lists the manual prints.

sources.title: PolyEight User Manual, Rev. 3 (2026-08-25)
sources.notes: NRPN mappings and SysEx preset parameters (PDF pages 17 - 21) read by tools/profiles/behringer/read-behringer-tables.mjs from Manual_BE_0722-ABA_POLYEIGHT_A4_WW_2026-08-25_Rev.3.pdf (sha256 7ae50ee0e0134e49b8bdec4051095e8b1c86be0e0dc890612c55f1e5e4eccca9), https://cdn-media.empowertribe.com/2613103449a6763dc1be198e419d1e80/Manual_BE_0722-ABA_POLYEIGHT_A4_WW_2026-08-25_Rev.3.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/behringer/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/behringer/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN mappings, sent as that NRPN with a 14-bit value (CC 6, then CC 38). Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Nothing is read back: the manual prints the preset dump's structure but no request for it, and gives the PolyEight's device ID bytes only as `Device-specific`.

Value lists taken from the preset parameter table, the NRPN table printing none: VCO pulse width modulation LFO waveform, MG retrigger mode selection, VCO octave selection, VCO waveform selection, VCA mode selection, Effect mode selection, MG additional waveform selection instead of S&H.

Printed 0–65535 and sent as 14 bits (0 - 16383), which is what data entry carries and what the preset table gives for them: Portamento speed/time value, Noise generator output level, Effect speed/depth parameter, VCO pulse width modulation depth, VCO pulse width modulation speed, Envelope generator attack time, Envelope generator decay time, Envelope generator sustain level, Envelope generator release time, Modulation generator frequency, Modulation generator delay time, Modulation generator output level, Filter cutoff frequency, Filter resonance/Q factor, Filter keyboard tracking amount, Envelope generator delay time, Gate envelope attack time, Gate envelope decay time, Gate envelope sustain level, Gate envelope release time, Bend wheel intensity proportional to bend range, Modulation generator frequency (NRPN 2307), Modulation generator output level (NRPN 2309).

Printed -32767–32767 (the preset table: -8192–8191), and laid out as the 14 bits sent, the manual not saying how a negative value is carried: Filter envelope intensity, Modulation matrix bus 1 amount, Modulation matrix bus 2 amount, Modulation matrix bus 3 amount, Modulation matrix bus 4 amount, Modulation matrix bus 5 amount, Modulation matrix bus 6 amount, Modulation matrix bus 7 amount, Modulation matrix bus 8 amount.

No range printed, and no value list found: the data byte's 0 - 127: Portamento legato mode, Unison envelope retrigger mode, Keyboard transpose setting preset, Modulation matrix bus 1 source selection, Modulation matrix bus 1 destination selection, Modulation matrix bus 2 source selection, Modulation matrix bus 2 destination selection, Modulation matrix bus 3 source selection, Modulation matrix bus 3 destination selection, Modulation matrix bus 4 source selection, Modulation matrix bus 4 destination selection, Modulation matrix bus 5 source selection, Modulation matrix bus 5 destination selection, Modulation matrix bus 6 source selection, Modulation matrix bus 6 destination selection, Modulation matrix bus 7 source selection, Modulation matrix bus 7 destination selection, Modulation matrix bus 8 source selection, Modulation matrix bus 8 destination selection, Arpeggiator enabled state.
Descriptions the table gives two NRPNs, both laid out: Modulation generator frequency (NRPN 2307), Modulation generator output level (NRPN 2309).
